description: One finished Dungeon Matcher Guild Bulwark enemy idle sprite per cell. This is a new member of the same human party as the supplied four humans. A compact, stout, bareheaded adventurer with a distinct hair silhouette and a readable face, wearing a worn blue travelling guild tunic, leather straps and a small ochre insignia. A single splendid BIG shield held tightly across his forward shoulder and thigh, low enough to leave his face fully visible. One boot, rear hand and some tunic plainly visible. Keep them distinct but siblings to the reference art. Brightest focus on the face, then shield crest. Old-school hand-placed RPG combat sprite, crisp connected shadows, warm brown-black fine outer ink, subdued material ramps, upper-left light. No white sclera, portrait anatomy, generic muscular knight, full plate armour or helmet. No scene, ground shadow, text, label or cell borders. Each cell holds exactly one whole figure from head to toe, generous transparent separation.
